verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs claim compiler-accurate, precise cross-file analysis for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, Scala, C# and Rust. Each finding reports the full source-to-sink call chain, which is taint-style tracing across function and file boundaries. One hands-on user reported two 100%-confidence findings that turned out to be false positives, which lowers confidence in accuracy but does not show the cross-file capability is absent. Missing for 10: technical documentation of how taint sources, sinks and sanitizers are modeled, and independent corroboration of accurate cross-file taint detection.
